items.name: Caphras Stone
items.currentDescription:
The immortal alchemist Caphras used stones as these as the ultimate catalyst. Sometimes referred to as the solar stone, the stone emits an intense and pure energy. It can be used to unlock the full potential of a gear without the risk of experiencing any dark, corrosive side effects.

- Usage: Increases the power of TRI (III) or higher gear via Caphras Enhancement

- {TextBind:KAFURAS_CLICK_RMB}

- How to Obtain: Quests, defeating monsters, Gathering, or Processing ({KeyBind:Manufacture}) - Simple Alchemy with the following materials

- Crafting Materials: 
Ancient Spirit Dust x5
Black Stone x1

- Materials for x10: 
Ancient Spirit Dust x50
Black Stone x10
Black Stone Powder x1

- Materials for x100:
Ancient Spirit Dust x500
Black Stone x100
Pure Powder Reagent x1

items.name: Black Gem
items.currentDescription:
A crystallized form of dark energy. It is used for enhancing a certain type of special equipment. More black gems are required for enhancement at higher enhancement levels.

- Usage: Enhance Life Skill gear or accessories

- How to Obtain: Gathering, Hunting or Processing ({KeyBind:Manufacture}) - Simple Alchemy with the following materials

- Materials #1:
Black Gem Fragment x1
Black Stone x2

- Materials #2: 
Black Gem Fragment x10
Black Stone x20
Black Stone Powder x1

- Materials #3: 
Black Gem Fragment x100
Black Stone x200
Pure Powder Reagent x1

items.name: Concentrated Magical Black Gem
items.currentDescription:
A crystallized form of concentrated dark energy. It is used for enhancing a certain type of equipment. More black gems are required for enhancement at higher enhancement levels.

- Usage: Enhance Life Skill gear and accessories

- Enhancements with this item will not be affected by your Enhancement Chance.

- How to Obtain: Processing ({KeyBind:Manufacture}) - Simple Alchemy with the following materials

- Materials #1: 
Black Gem x5
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x2

- Materials #2:
Black Gem x50
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x20
Black Stone Powder x1

- Materials #3: 
Black Gem x500
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x200
Pure Powder Reagent x1

items.name: Imperfect Lightstone of Flora
items.currentDescription:
A lightstone that contains imperfect flora energy.

- Usage: Craft Purified Lightstone of Flora

- Crafting Method #1: Alchemy in your residence if at least Alchemy Guru 1

- Crafting Materials:
Imperfect Lightstone of Flora x1
Black Gem Fragment or Magical Lightstone Crystal x10
Black Stone x10
Powder of Time x50
Pure Powder Reagent x50

- Crafting Method #2: Hand over Imperfect Lightstone of Flora x1 and 20,000,000 Silver to  Dalishain located in major cities and towns.

- How to Obtain: Life Skill activities according to a set probability
